title: I believe we need as many human as technical solutions but I have been annotating for credibility for quite some time. Surface level markers possible
summary: I believe we need as many human as technical solutions but I have been annotating for credibility for quite some time. Surface level markers possible for machine learning now. Will the nuance and perspectives be in the future? Don't know, but cars drive themselves now. #credweb
